newsitem.title: USA: First USA says trust oks securities exchange.
newsitem.headline: First USA says trust oks securities exchange.

text.p: First USA Inc and its Delaware business trust said Friday they had accepted about $118.975 million of the trust's 9.33 percent series A capital securities for exchange into the trust's 9.33 percent series B capital securities.
The trust is called First USA Capital Trust I.

First USA's pending tender offer to buy the trust's outstanding 9.33 percent outstanding series A capital securities and 9.33 percent series B capital securities at $1,172.50 per $1,000 liquidation amount will continue.
The tender offer and withdrawal rights will expire on June 30.
First USA is a financial services company focusing on the credit card business.
